title: Goldie T NDE 7799
content: I looked down at my body. I felt no weight as I floated above myself. A black circle appeared; at first, it was small and then it grew larger. I could pass beside it, around it, and behind it, yet it looked the same. Then I entered the black circle that turned into a tunnel with a light at the end. There was no pain. The light was comforting, entirely comforting and welcoming. I went toward it. Around me were darkness and a void. It was kind of like a tunnel. I was heading for the light when I heard my sister call my name. Her voice in that tunnel was more than a voice. Her voice was like lightening in a night sky as it passed through the tunnel and then past by me as it went on to the light. Then I heard another voice say, 'Go back. It's not time.' I screamed, 'No!' I didn't want to go back. Then I felt something or someone grab my legs and drag me backward away from the light. On being dragged backward, I became aware of other beings in the dark around me. They were grabbing at me but did not grasp me. I was dragged backward, out of the same black circle that I had entered. I turned and saw my body. Both, my sister and significant other were doing CPR on me. My sister was crying, pleading for me to come back. I looked for the entranceway back to the light. The black circle closed and prevented me from reentering the tunnel with the light. I had nowhere to go but back into my body. I sat on my body, laid down into it and awoke in terrible pain and gasping.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: A 'black circle' appeared, grew larger, and when entered it 'turned into a tunnel with a light at the end.'
tunnel.movement_other_detail: She was 'grab[bed]' by the legs and 'drag[ged]... backward away from the light.'

arrival.other_being_detail: In the darkness around her, she became aware of 'other beings... grabbing at me but did not grasp me.'

environment.environment_other_detail: Darkness/void around her; tunnel-like space with a light at the end.

boundary_and_return.return_method_other_detail: Felt grabbed by the legs and 'drag[ged]... backward' away from the light; then the black circle 'closed' and she 'sat on my body, laid down into it and awoke.'

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Also reported hearing her sister call her name; awareness of other beings in the dark; observing CPR on her body.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (viewed body) → black circle/tunnel with light → heard voices → told 'Go back. It's not time.' → dragged back; black circle closed (boundary) → reentered body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: The 'black circle' that could be passed beside/around/behind before entering; sister's voice described as 'like lightening in a night sky' traveling through the tunnel toward the light; dark beings 'grabbing at me but did not grasp me.'
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Go back. It's not time.”; “No!”; “Her voice was like lightening in a night sky as it passed through the tunnel and then past by me as it went on to the light.”
